display.purpose: Hero headlines only. One per page.

label.purpose: Button text, form labels, nav items.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default for color and opacity transitions. Instant-feeling, no choreography.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary CTA. Emerald fill, used for the single most important action on each screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #059669; color: #fff; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #10b981; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #94a3b8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions. Transparent with border. Used alongside primary buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #cbd5e1; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1e293b; color: #f8fafc; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #94a3b8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card Surface
components.description: Content container for portfolios, template previews, and form sections.
components.html:
Corporate Portfolio

Navy & gold institutional design.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5); border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-card-title { color: #f8fafc; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-desc { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Accent Chip
components.description: Feature tags and template capability badges.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.1); color: #10b981; font-size: 0.75rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form fields in the portfolio builder wizard.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #1e293b; color: #cbd5e1; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #059669; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Fixed top navigation with brand mark, nav links, and CTA.
components.html:
Portfolio Pro
Sign In
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 24px; background: rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-nav-brand { color: #f8fafc; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-nav-link { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #f8fafc; } .ds-nav-cta { font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 16px; }

narrative.overview:
A designer's private workshop: precise, unhurried, expert. Dark surfaces recede so the work (portfolio templates) stands forward. Emerald accents are deliberate and rare, marking only the actions that matter. The tool never competes with what it produces.

Portfolio Pro's visual language serves GCC professionals who expect polish without pretension. The interface says "we've already made the design decisions" through craft, not decoration. Every surface is dark enough to let template previews and content breathe, but warm enough (slate, not pure black) to avoid the cold-tool cliche.
keyCharacteristics: Dark workshop surfaces with tinted slate neutrals, never pure black
Single emerald accent used with restraint; its rarity is the point
Geist typeface throughout, hierarchy driven by scale and weight
Flat elevation with border-based separation; no shadows
Content-forward: template previews and user work dominate

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Atelier Emerald appears on no more than 10% of any screen. Its power comes from scarcity.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries a blue undertone (chroma 0.013-0.019 in the 250-265 hue range). Pure gray is forbidden.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: Adjacent hierarchy levels must differ by at least one weight step (100) AND one size step (ratio >= 1.25).

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Geist only. No decorative fonts, no serif pairings, no monospace for emphasis.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow on any app surface. Shadows are reserved for portfolio templates, not the builder UI.

rules.name: The Blur Exception
rules.body: backdrop-blur permitted only on fixed navbar and overlay backdrops. Nowhere else.

dos: Do use Atelier Emerald exclusively for primary actions and success states.
Do tint every neutral toward slate-blue.
Do let template previews dominate the visual hierarchy.
Do treat Arabic RTL as a native layout.
Do use borders (1px, Frame Line) as the primary separation mechanism.
Do keep motion to transition-colors and transition-opacity.
donts: Don't use gradient blobs, glassmorphism cards, or hero-metric templates.
Don't use box-shadow on app surfaces.
Don't scatter emerald across the interface (max 10% of any screen).
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use identical card grids (same-size cards with icon + heading + text repeated).
Don't use pure black (#000) or pure white (#fff).
Don't introduce a second font family.
Don't build layouts that look like Wix or generic WordPress themes.
Don't use warm beige backgrounds, soft illustrations, or rounded-everything.
